finding_dispositions.evidence: Installed runtime and policy trust roots are durable, immutable, digest-pinned, and schema-validated.
Task security contexts derive binding, clock, classification, provenance, redaction, and review trust from current durable state.
Disclosure validation binds the concrete destination, prepared action, payload, authority, and delivered durable receipt.
Purge authorization transactionally rereads current subjects, holds, dependencies, claims, and consumes one exact authorization.
Path/symlink handling and recursive redaction fail closed under configured resource limits.
Raw core issuers are absent; the production application issuer accepts durable record identities only and uses the immutable installed pin.
Disclosure attestations are issued only from delivered or reconciled durable journal entries with exact digest bindings.
Retention authorization rereads current durable blockers and enforces one-use transactional consumption.

Installed-runtime, task-state, and disclosure-journal JSON all use charged bounded parsing; over-depth input returns RepositoryIntegrityError caused by ContractError E_LIMIT, never raw RecursionError.
